tags.en: one hand resting on own cheek tilting head

tags.en: both hands clasped together in front of chest
one arm stretched out pointing at the viewer

fingers curled into a loose fist near the chin

tags.en: hand pressed flat against own chest
arms spread wide open as if welcoming someone

tags.en: hands tucked into sleeves of a kimono

tags.en: fingers lightly tapping own cheek in thought
tags.zh: 手指轻点脸颊像是在思考

tags.en: one hand adjusting the brim of a hat
both hands pressing down the hem of a skirt
standing with weight shifted onto one leg
tags.zh: 重心压在一条腿上站着

tags.en: standing on tiptoes reaching for a high shelf

tags.en: leaning back against a wall with one knee bent

tags.en: sitting on the edge of a windowsill swinging legs

tags.en: lying on stomach propped up on elbows
tags.zh: 趴着用手肘撑起上半身

tags.en: lying on back with arms stretched above head
kneeling on one knee while looking up
walking forward with hair and skirt flowing behind

tags.en: running with one arm swung back

tags.en: jumping mid-air with both legs tucked
spinning around so that the skirt flares out
stretching both arms upward after waking up
bending forward to pick something up
turning head over shoulder to look back
standing still with hands hanging loosely at sides
tags.zh: 静静站着双手自然垂在身侧

tags.en: resting chin on both hands at a desk
shoulders relaxed and posture completely at ease
tags.zh: 肩膀放松姿态十分松弛

tags.en: smiling gently with eyes slightly closed
laughing out loud with head tilted back
eyes wide open in surprise with mouth slightly open

tags.en: frowning slightly with a worried look
biting lower lip with a shy expression

tags.en: closing eyes peacefully as if sleeping

tags.en: grinning with a hint of mischief

tags.en: soft smile with a faint blush on cheeks

tags.en: surprised expression with hands covering mouth

tags.en: looking up at the sky with a dreamy gaze

tags.en: looking down at own hands quietly
tags.zh: 安静地低头看着自己的手

tags.en: gazing at the viewer through strands of hair

tags.en: walking through a rain soaked street at night

tags.en: standing under a streetlight in the falling snow
sitting by the window watching the rain fall
waiting at a bus stop in the early morning
running through a field of tall grass
lying on the grass watching clouds drift by
reading a book under a tree in the afternoon
drying hair with a towel after a bath
holding a warm cup with both hands on a cold day

tags.en: eating ice cream while walking along the beach

tags.en: sitting on a rooftop overlooking the city at dusk

tags.en: standing on a crowded train holding the strap

tags.en: lying on a bed scrolling through a phone
cooking something in a small kitchen
watering plants on a balcony in the morning

tags.en: leaning over a railing looking at the river below
tags.zh: 靠在栏杆上望着下面的河

tags.en: standing in a doorway with light behind
walking away down a long empty corridor
sitting alone in an empty classroom after school
tags.zh: 放学后独自坐在空教室里

tags.en: holding an umbrella against the wind
standing in a shallow river with feet in the water
tags.zh: 站在浅溪里双脚浸在水里

tags.en: looking out of a train window at passing scenery
tags.zh: 望着车窗外掠过的风景

tags.en: hugging a large plush toy tightly
holding hands while walking side by side
embracing tightly with faces close together
one person carrying another on their back
leaning head on the other person shoulder
facing each other at a short distance
whispering into the other person ear
playfully poking the other person cheek
sharing an umbrella in the rain
helping the other person tie their hair
sitting back to back on the floor
flowing silk dress catching the light
oversized sweater with sleeves covering hands

tags.zh: 丝带和系带松松地飘动

tags.en: lace trim catching a soft glow

tags.en: wet clothes clinging to the body
scarf wrapped up to the chin
skirt lifted slightly by an updraft
tags.zh: 裙子被一阵上升气流微微掀起

tags.en: hair tie slipping loose letting hair fall
tags.zh: 发绳松脱长发散落下来

tags.en: jewelry glinting as the body turns

tags.en: bare feet on a wooden floor
stockings with a small run in them
